documentTitle.zh: 溢出测试夹具-服务说明

tagline.zh: 故意塞满双语正文与清单细节以触发导出溢出失败
tagline.en: Packed bilingual details to force export overflow

summary.zh: 本夹具面向工程验收：在紧凑密度重试后仍应溢出单页 A4，确保导出以非零退出并写入失败截图。
summary.en: Must still overflow one A4 after compact retry so export exits non-zero with a screenshot.

profiles.zh: 成绩优秀但时间线混乱需要强节点管理的学生
profiles.en: Strong grades but chaotic timeline needing milestones

profiles.zh: 首次接触英本申请流程的家长希望同步信息
profiles.en: First-time UK UG parents needing shared visibility

profiles.zh: 同时准备标化考试与活动叙事的双线候选人
profiles.en: Candidates juggling testing and activity narrative

intro.zh: 以下交付项均含完整双语说明与额外细节段落，用于制造垂直空间压力。
intro.en: Each deliverable includes full bilingual labels plus long detail blocks for vertical pressure.

label.zh: 选校定位与名单策略（含专业匹配）
label.en: School list strategy and major fit analysis

detail.zh: 覆盖定位访谈、专业方向梳理、冲刺/匹配/保底分层、专业录取数据对照、家长共识会纪要，以及后续名单变更的版本管理与理由记录，确保决策可追溯。
detail.en: Includes discovery interviews, major mapping, reach/match/safety tiers, admissions data checks, parent consensus notes, and versioned list change logs so every decision is traceable.

label.zh: 主文书与补充文书多轮修改

detail.zh: 从素材采集、故事主线、结构大纲、多轮中英修订到最终定稿检查，包含活动叙事一致性审查与字数合规，避免模板化表达并保留学生真实声音。
detail.en: From material mining and story spine through outlines, multi-round CN/EN edits, final polish, activity narrative consistency, and word-count compliance while keeping the student voice.

label.zh: 推荐信指导与递交清单管理
label.en: Reference guidance and submission checklist ops

detail.zh: 协助梳理推荐人选择、要点包准备、时间提醒与平台递交状态核对，维护总清单避免漏交材料，并在关键窗口同步风险与补救路径。
detail.en: Referee selection, brag-sheet prep, deadline pings, portal status checks, master checklist hygiene, and risk/remediation sync at critical windows.

label.zh: 关键节点规划与家长同步会
label.en: Milestone plan and parent sync meetings

detail.zh: 制定学期级与周级节点，覆盖标化、活动、文书、递交与面试准备；定期同步会输出纪要与待办，保证家庭与顾问信息同频。
detail.en: Term and weekly milestones across testing, activities, essays, submissions, and interview prep; recurring syncs with minutes and actions for family-counselor alignment.

label.zh: 面试准备与模拟演练纪要
label.en: Interview prep with mock session notes

detail.zh: 题库梳理、结构化作答训练、两轮模拟与书面反馈，覆盖学术兴趣、活动深挖与临场表达，并给出下一轮改进清单。
detail.en: Question banks, structured answers, two mocks with written feedback on academic interest, activity depth, delivery, and a next-round improvement list.

label.zh: 递交后跟进与补件策略建议

detail.zh: 跟踪状态更新、补件通知响应、等待期沟通节奏与结果解读框架，帮助家庭在不确定阶段保持可执行的下一步。
detail.en: Status tracking, additional-document responses, wait-period communication cadence, and outcome framing so families always have a next executable step.

intro.zh: 客户侧配合事项全部展开细节，确保即使 compact 密度仍无法装入单页。
intro.en: Client-side requirements expanded so even compact density cannot fit one page.

label.zh: 提供近两年成绩单与标化考试规划
label.en: Provide two-year transcripts and testing plan

detail.zh: 需包含课程名称、分数说明、预估分与重考计划；标化科目、目标分与备考周计划需书面确认，便于顾问校准选校与时间线。
detail.en: Course names, grade context, predicted scores, retake plans; testing subjects, targets, and weekly prep must be confirmed in writing for list and timeline calibration.

label.zh: 按节点完成活动与文书素材收集
label.en: Meet activity and essay material deadlines

detail.zh: 素材包括活动职责、影响力证据、个人转折事件与可用数据；逾期将挤压修改轮次并可能影响冲刺校策略。
detail.en: Materials include roles, impact evidence, turning points, and metrics; lateness compresses edit rounds and may weaken reach-school strategy.

label.zh: 家长参与关键节点确认（选校/递交）

detail.zh: 选校分层、预算边界与最终递交名单需家长签字确认；缺席确认将暂停冲刺动作直至对齐完成。
detail.en: List tiers, budget bounds, and final submit set require parent sign-off; missing confirmation pauses reach actions until aligned.

label.zh: 保持周沟通并及时反馈修改意见
label.en: Maintain weekly comms and timely edit feedback

detail.zh: 约定响应时限内回复批注；无反馈视为同意当前稿进入下一流程，责任共担。
detail.en: Reply to annotations within agreed SLAs; silence is treated as approval to advance, with shared ownership.

label.zh: 准备推荐人联系方式与要点包
label.en: Prepare referee contacts and brag sheets

detail.zh: 提前两周提供推荐人邮箱、关系说明与成就要点，避免临近截止的催办风险。
detail.en: Provide referee emails, relationship context, and achievement bullets two weeks early to avoid deadline chase risk.

label.zh: 配合模拟面试并完成复盘作业
label.en: Join mocks and complete debrief homework

detail.zh: 每次模拟后提交书面反思与改写答案；缺席将影响面试准备完整度评估。
detail.en: After each mock, submit written reflection and revised answers; absences affect readiness assessment.

label.zh: 授权必要平台账号只读协同

detail.zh: 用于状态核对与清单勾选；不替代学生本人最终提交操作。
detail.en: For status checks and checklist ticks only; does not replace the student final submit action.

label.zh: 确认信息真实并签署服务边界说明

detail.zh: 所有成绩、活动与身份信息须真实可核；顾问不代写不可核验内容，不承诺录取结果。
detail.en: All grades, activities, and identity facts must be verifiable; counselors do not fabricate content or guarantee outcomes.

items.zh: 一对一顾问全周期陪伴与纪要闭环
节点制管理覆盖标化文书递交面试
items.en: Milestones for tests, essays, and submit

items.zh: 双语材料同步降低家庭沟通成本
溢出夹具专用请勿用于真实销售
items.en: Overflow fixture only — not for sales
